notes.title: The store page for “Mercenaries Lament” is now open!
notes.content:
The long wait is over!
The official store page for “Mercenaries Lament: Requiem of the Silver Wolf”, the newest game of the Mercenaries series, is now open for viewing.
We hope you’ll consider adding it to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2321040/Mercenaries_Lament/


[h3]A prayer for the fallen to rise from the depths of despair—[/h3]

The characters are beautifully drawn with rich facial expressions by the illustrator Sakura Mochi!


[Story]
Several years have passed since a mysterious disease with no cure quickly spread across the continent.
Those infected would suffer a horrible fate of turning into zombies after their death, mindlessly attacking the living. It has become the norm for hired mercenaries to spend countless days clearing the lands of the undead.
Such a mercenary is Johann, captain of the Silver Wolf Mercenary Company. He is paid a visit by the Grim Reaper, and narrowly escapes its blade of death, but the Reaper leaves him with an eerie prophecy: "In the next 100 days, your luck shall run out. That shall be the day of your fate.”
After awaking from a delirious slumber, he is met by a young woman with miraculous powers that can heal people from the disease.
Was his encounter with the Grim Reaper but a nightmare....?
Regardless, Johann offers to protect the miracle worker on her travels to save as many people as she can. They set out on a journey to travel the kingdom, curing the infected.
Soon, however, Johann must confront his mortality…


ーーーーーーー

" Mercenaries Saga -Will of the White Lions-" to be released in STEAM winter of 2023!

The first installment of the Tactics RPG series and predecessor to "Mercenaries Blaze" will return with a Steam version that is even easier to play!

[i][Story]
Fornea, the Green Continent is known for its vast expanses and warm climate.
Stretching from the south to west is the Flare Kingdom, who has been conquering its neighboring countries in the recent years. 
In the southern tip lies the Kingdom of Mondoa. Fearing the growing power of Flare, Mondoa invades Sekrak, a smaller country to its north in attempt to obtain more territory. 

Mondoa is met with fierce resistance. As the war drags on, this situation brings great joy to mercenaries who fight for coin. Many large mercenary companies use the opportunity to line their pockets with gold.
However, things are different for those without an established name. 
Our story differs in many ways, focusing on the young commander Leon and his troop of but six fresh-faced mercenaries: The White Lions…

" Mercenaries Saga 2 -Order of the Sliver Eagle-" to be released in STEAM winter of 2023!

The second installment of the Tactics RPG series and predecessor to "Mercenaries Blaze" will return with a Steam version that is even easier to play!

[i]【The Story】
The stable rule of the large country on the western continent came to an end, leaving many small countries fighting for territory.

In the eastern part of this continent is a certain kingdom, protected by the snowy valleys to its north and the wide mountain range to its west. Though it is but a small kingdom, it has a long, proud history of being an independent nation.

Legend has it that the ancestors of the royal family were mere soldiers back in the Era of Gods, but became chosen heroes after defeating the Fiends of Darkness.

But as their long peace stretched on, and though the heroes blood passed through their veins, the kings grew complacent. Soon enough they were respected in name only as mediocre kings came and went in succession.
The current ruler, King Salud, is another simple man. Though he is beloved by his people, he has yet to make any great achievements in politics.

And thus the kingdom continues its slow decline, while places away from the royal capital were beset by new evils and monsters...  
 [/i]

Mercenaries Saga 3 -Gray Wolves of War- 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2142250/3/


"Mercenaries Saga 3 -Gray Wolves of War-" to be released in STEAM winter of 2023!

The third installment of the Tactics RPG series and predecessor to "Mercenaries Blaze" will return with a Steam version that is even easier to play!




[i]【The Story】
Long ago there were two continents, split into north and south by a large ocean.
These two continents underwent vastly different development.

In the north continent, the Flare Kingdom, with their advanced industry and powerful military background, expanded their sphere of influence.
They annexed neighboring states until the entire north continent was under their control.

On the other hand, the tribes of the Kirialos country in the southern continent were at constant war.
Having achieved domination of their own continent, the Flare Kingdom set their sights on Kirialos's resources.

The Flare Kingdom intervened in the wars on the south continent in the name of peacekeeping but took complete control in the blink of an eye.

Their plan was to set up a puppet government in Kirialos, whilst syphoning the wealth obtained from its resources back to their own continent.

That's when the "Liberation Army" appeared - its sights set on overthrowing the Kingdom.

To deal with this uprising, the Kingdom set up a local ministry of war.
The name of the Kingdom's foreign campaign regiment was "Coronea"―

The mercenaries who joined this unit, be it for money, fame or honor, became known as the "Kingdom's Dogs".

This is the story of the smallest, most insignificant mercenary company among them: The Gray Wolves mercenaries.

[/i]

notes.title: 「Mercenaries Rebirth: Call of the Wild Lynx」Store Page Release！
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. It's Kou from FHW.

Today, we are proud to announce the release of the classic tactical simulation RPG[b]「Mercenaries Rebirth: Call of the Wild Lynx」[/b]'s STEAM Store Page.


[previewyoutube=Yx9YSS0lKow;full][/previewyoutube]


●STEAM【Mercenaries Rebirth Store Page】

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867810/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867810/[/url]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609327/632446e9aac1fa71c444cc3a9f58814fbf8c78ea.jpg[/img]

[h3]Princess, with your Mercenaries, take up the sword and rise to victory！[/h3]

「Mercenaries Rebirth」is a [b]Tactical Simulation RPG[/b] set in a fantasy world. 

Battles occur on quarter-view maps with height differences, wherein the front, back, and side of the map determine each battle’s outcome. Support effects depend on where allied characters from your party are in position, etc., features of high strategic maneuvers.

 
Enjoy a high degree of character cultivation by using skill points earned in battles, skill acquisition, enhancements, class change, etc. 


Talented Illustrator [b]Makimura Shunsuke san[/b] is the appointed character designer! Beautifully drawn characters play more active roles with rich facial expressions that vary from joy, sadness, anger, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609327/e5ccf9d858ffd12198a68c933d35ab652f69c5ad.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609327/9ad620d23d1f36bb47d9e94dce6273351e997098.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609327/77e44fff4ca876a1be8c88ce769a39166b3399ac.jpg[/img]


[h3]Rebirth Exceed is the key to victory! [/h3]

The gauge in the upper right corner of the screen builds up anytime the Player attacks and defends during battles. 

Store enough power to activate a particular skill called [b]「Rebirth Exceed」[/b]!

Each character has unique talents, including dealing with godly damage to enemies and reviving fallen allies who cannot fight.

Rebirth Exceed is the key to victory!
